How it works
1 Generate Tests, written by code From a list of what your agent can face.
2 Run Your agent Each test, several times.
3 Check and judge A verdict for every step Rules first, then model judges.
4 Gate Better or worse? Your CI blocks a change that made it worse.
5 Fix The step that broke The report names the step and the reason.
6 Rerun Only what the fix touches The other results are kept.
Fix, rerun what changed, check again.
